title: Model-tailored quant calibration + layer-normalizer harness for FP8/INT8
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build a reusable calibration and validation harness that produces model-specific quantization profiles (FP8 and INT8) and applies layer-wise normalization scalars to mitigate activation spikes for LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen families. Deliverables: (1) calibration pipeline that collects representative activation distributions and emits per-layer scaling maps, (2) runtime-compatible profile format that supports selective float preservation for fragile layers, (3) automated accuracy regression checks for PRs, and (4) documentation + runbook for model onboarding into runtime-1.22.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Asha Kapoor: Kickoff. We observed model-specific activation spike modes on Qwen-14B and Mistral-7B that break naive per-tensor min/max calibration. Proposed solution: collect 99.999th percentile tails per-channel, compute a layer-normalizer scalar (multiplicative) and an optional per-channel clamp. Target runtime format: profile contains candidates for FP8 and INT8 packing plus a hint flag to keep layer in float if accuracy loss > threshold.

2025-02-21 - Miguel Torres: Prototype completed. Added a small harness that runs 1k representative batches for each model (mix of chat prompts / wiki / code). Harness outputs JSON maps with per-layer stats: p50, p99, p999, max, skew, kurtosis. Early results: LLaMA-2-70B requires mild downscaling on early transformer layers (0-6) to avoid overflow in FP8; Qwen-14B shows heavy tail on attention projection weights in layers 10-14.

2025-02-24 - Riley Chen (review): Reviewed prototype artifacts. Feedback: (a) move from global percentile to dynamic percentile (windowed) to avoid dataset-dependent mis-scaling, (b) add unit tests that compare perplexity on heldout eval prompts pre/post quantization, (c) integrate a fallback that pins layer to float if accuracy delta > 0.5% on validation set.

2025-02-26 - Miguel Torres: Implemented layer-normalizer stage. Algorithm: compute layer scalar s = max(1.0, p999 / target_clip), where target_clip is learned per-model target (default 7.5 for FP8, 2.5 for INT8). Apply s as multiplicative factor on activations during offline calibration and embed inverse into profile so runtime divides activations before packing. Added selective float-preserve marker for layers exceeding curvature threshold.

2025-02-28 - Performance tests: Benchmarks against baseline float serve on internal suites. FP8 profiles with layer-normalizer show median latency improvement of 1.9x and token cost reduction of ~48% vs float, while keeping rank correlation on open-domain QA accuracy within 0.3% for LLaMA-2-70B and Mistral-7B. Qwen-14B required pinning 6 layers to float to stay within 0.5% accuracy threshold; cost reduction netted ~30% for that model.

2025-03-01 - PR opened: runtime PR #2435 adds support for 'layer_scalars' field in profile schema and runtime logic to apply prepack scaling and optional float-preserve. Requesting review from @riley and @samira for accuracy gating and @infra for perf regressions.

2025-03-02 - Design/PM sync: Decided on UI surface in Console: per-model profile viewer showing layers with scalars and a toggle to force float-preserve. PM asked for an explanation tooltip and a 'why pinned' reason (e.g., 'activation-tail-heavy, accuracy risk').

2025-03-03 - Miguel Torres: Running extended calibration sweep (10k batches) to refine target_clip defaults and update CI regression thresholds. Preparing runbook and Confluence high-level design. Next: add automated eval job in CI that fails PRs if accuracy delta > 0.5% or latency regression > 10%.
test_summary: Unit tests: added synthetic activations generator + percentile extractor. Coverage: per-layer scalar generation logic.

Eval harness: 2,400 prompt eval set (mix chat, code, summarization). Metrics: top-1 token accuracy, ROUGE-L, and custom semantic similarity score. Current pass: LLaMA/Mistral FP8 profiles within 0.3% of baseline on primary metrics.
Stress tests: quantized models run on p4d and a100 pools; no memory safety issues observed. Qwen required extra float-preserve layers to avoid hallucination regressions.
Perf: FP8 end-to-end throughput +1.8x median; INT8 offers +1.4x but with tighter accuracy trade-offs for some models.
CI gating plan: add nightly full-sweep for newly onboarded model profiles; PR-level smoke tests run a 200-sample eval set within the calibration harness.
next_steps: Finish extended calibration sweep (due 2025-03-07) to lock target_clip defaults per model family.
Finalize runtime PR feedback and merge runtime/pull/2435 after infra sign-off.
Add CI job to run the 200-sample smoke eval on PRs touching profile generation code.
Author runbook + Console UX copy explaining 'float-preserve' and layer scalars.
Coordinate with Model Onboarding (PM) to vet profiles before public release and add model-specific notes for Mistral/Qwen families.
